title: Changelog
description: What changed on xitter lately - new features and fixes, newest first.

sections.heading: Pages defined in the CMS
sections.body: This page is the newest feature: pages created in the CMS now render at their own address, the same as the home and About pages. Editors draft and publish them with live preview - no code change, no deploy.

sections.heading: Why this page exists
sections.body: It is committed as seed content, so it survives the nightly reset like everything else worth keeping. Expect entries here to grow as the demo does.
